title: Hire Purchase Agreement
bindingStatement: This agreement is made between the Lessor and the Lessee, and both parties agree to the terms specified below.
legalDeclarations: The Lessee acknowledges and agrees to pay according to the installment schedule below. Ownership transfers only after all payments have cleared.

penalty.legalText: If payment is late beyond the grace period, the Lessee agrees to pay a penalty at the specified rate, not to exceed the stated maximum cap.
